title: Very disappointing.
body:
If this is truly “built by ADHDers” as claimed, you might want to re-think the 7 day free trial. I got no benefit whatsoever from the 7 days because, SUFFERING FROM ADHD, I was unable to get into a habit of consistently using the app during such a short period. 7 days is hardly enough time for anyone to build beneficial habits, let alone a subset of the population that find such things very difficult. I would have thought fellow ADHDers would know that. 

The pricing is also exorbitant, they have mentioned in other reviews some sort of finance scheme. I enquired about this scheme but have not heard anything back about it. So, at the end of my free trial I’m basically left high and dry - I didn’t benefit from the app in such a short timeframe, and I also have no desire to take a leap of faith in continuing to use the app by committing to spend €49.99 to try another month.
author: mutant32z

title: Scam and overpriced be ready to fork over 20 bucks a month.
body:
I don’t usually write reviews let alone negative ones, but wow. Just wow.

You can’t use this app without an obscenely expensive plan that adds up to hundreds a year. I’m already struggling to pay my medication instead. Don’t bother installing, you won’t get any use of it and there’s actually better alternatives that even if not free are not disgustingly expensive to the point I question if they even care and don’t just want to profit off disabled people and put a massive price tag on it when they become dependant on your schedule on the app as happens with ADHD. No thank you.
